title: BEFORE DEMANDS BEGIN
Morning Solitude in Luke 4:42
end: The Morning Altar — begin every sunrise in prayer
stock_queries: serene dawn sky over calm water

scenes.a: Before the world demands your whole attention today,
you might feel pulled to give yourself away to every voice asking for your time before you even pray.
Scripture records, And when it was day, he departed and went into a desert place: and the people sought him, and came unto him, and stayed him, that he should not depart from them.
scenes.sub: HE DEPARTED TO A DESERT PLACE

scenes.a: Lord, before the noise of this morning rushes in, teach us to seek quiet places with You.
scenes.sub: TEACH US TO SEEK YOUR SILENCE

scenes.a: When duties press in from every side, help us anchor our hearts in Your quiet strength.
Amen. Before the world demands your whole attention today.
